task.title: Migrate change and diff-table source root
task.summary: Move change traceability types/helpers and runtime diff-table tool ownership into src/change/** while preserving decision-row approval behavior.

goal.outcome: Change traceability and diff-table approval runtime have source-root ownership under src/change/**.
acceptance: Create src/change/** owner modules for change types, traceability normalization/exemption helpers, runtime diff table types, diff-table storage/mutation use cases, and codewiki_diff_table tool execution.
Update schemas, build/validation/graph callers, adapters, tests, and package smoke to import change/diff-table behavior from src/change/** or stable public API paths.
Remove old src/domain/change/**, src/application/diff-table.ts, and src/application/tools/diff-table.ts owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.
Preserve codewiki_diff_table schema/result behavior, decision_build diff table shape, traceability policy behavior, package loading, and direct Node execution.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy change/diff-table imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project, knowledge, roadmap, session, state/graph/resume, GC, adapters/UI, or skills.
Do not change decision diff-table semantics, public tool schemas, traceability enum values, build JSON schema, or validation report schema.
